news.title: Man hit by bus, killed at busy downtown Atlanta intersection
news.summary: A man died after being hit by a bus in downtown Atlanta.

news.title: Man hit, killed by bus in southwest Atlanta on Thursday morning
news.summary: A man was struck and killed by a FlixBus in southwest Atlanta on Thursday morning.

news.title: Man known for 'Florida Boy' tattoo convicted of trafficking and raping 15-year-old in metro Atlanta
news.summary: Christopher Clark, who was known for his "Florida Boy" tattoo in a sketch released by Georgia investigators in June 2022, was accused of raping a 15-year-old girl.

news.title: Suspect death in Mexico prompts closure of Roswell murder case
news.summary: Roswell police have officially closed the investigation into the Christmas Eve 2024 murder of Blanca Sauer after confirming the suspect died by suicide in Mexico.

news.title: Riverdale man sentenced for rape, trafficking of teen girl
news.summary: A Riverdale man was sentenced to 20 years in prison after pleading guilty Wednesday to the rape, false imprisonment and trafficking of a 15-year-old girl in Clayton County, officials said.

news.title: Suspect in custody after shooting injures 2 teens in northwest Atlanta
news.summary: The incident occurred in the Joseph E. Boone Boulevard area near Kipp Ways Academy Charter School.

news.title: 2 people wounded in overnight DeKalb County shooting
news.summary: Two people were wounded in an overnight shooting in DeKalb County.

news.title: Atlanta shootings injure 3 men; at least 30 rounds hit home
news.summary: Three men were hospitalized and a home was struck by at least 30 rounds of gunfire during three overnight shootings across Atlanta, police said.

news.title: Clayton police release rendering to help identify human remains
news.summary: Clayton County police are asking for the community's help to identify a man after human remains were recovered in the area.

news.title: FBI Atlanta increases reward for suspect wanted for kidnapping, extortion
news.summary: According to the agency, Julious George Khalid and others portrayed themselves as law enforcement and stopped a victim at gunpoint on I-20 near Panola Road.

news.title: Investigation into suspected cocaine trafficking from Acworth home leads to 4 arrests
news.summary: The Cherokee Multi-Agency Narcotics Squad (CMANS) received information that residents inside a home on Valley Farm Lane were allegedly trafficking cocaine.
